Scarlet & Violet series · JTG

Journey Together

Released March 28, 2025 · 190 cards

StandardExpanded

Journey Together is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on March 28, 2025. Its main set has 159 cards, plus 31 secret rares numbered beyond the set (190 in total). It includes 168 Pokémon, 20 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
